label: r1c2
name: Frames x centred window x 2 orders
hypothesis: The mismatch may combine a dihedral remap, an anchor-corner offset and anchor-major flattening. A shared centred 3x3 (2K-1) window conv outputs per-frame type maps. Each map is re-indexed into its frame and flattened both type-major and anchor-major (16 components, ×5 softmax). A gain-0.01 dense term comes from the global vector. Dev above 0 here while candidate 1 stays at 0 would point to an anchor offset or ordering mismatch. All 0 refutes it.
